name: AI-PROMPT-music-f4530c07331c
annotation:
Night defense combat loop matching wave tiers; seamless loop

Night defense combat music loop for a top-down 1930s cursed-island survival game. 95-105 BPM, pulsing low percussion like oars against hull wood, tense sustained strings, dissonant brass stabs when a wave spawns, a distant sunken-bell motif that doubles as the enemy telegraph sound. Builds intensity in three tiers matching night-wave tiers. Muted teal-and-brass palette mood, dread without chaos. 120 seconds, seamless loop, no vocals. Deliver 48 kHz WAV plus OGG; loopable.
